---
title: "Example: volcano plot"
description: >
  A small analysis app with hosted inputs, value boxes, a Shiny module and a
  brand theme, with an R server and a React client.
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

`examples/volcano-plot` is a small analysis app with the usual bslib shape:
controls in a sidebar, a row of value boxes, and a plot in a card. It was
ported from a plain bslib app, and the server kept its shape. Only the layout
moved to React.

![The volcano plot app: five controls in a sidebar, three value boxes
counting up, down and not significant genes, and a volcano plot in a
card.](https://www.samuelbharti.com/bslibreact/assets/volcano.png)

## Run it

The built client is committed, so the app runs without Node:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/samuelbharti/bslibreact.git
```

```{r}
install.packages(c("pak", "shinyreact", "ggplot2", "ggrepel", "brand.yml"))
pak::pak("samuelbharti/bslibreact/pkg-r")
shiny::runApp("bslibreact/examples/volcano-plot")
```

Give the full path if R's working directory is not the folder that holds the
clone.

## The page

`src/App.tsx` lays out the whole page. Each component stands for one bslib
call: `PageSidebar` for `page_sidebar()`, `LayoutColumns` for
`layout_columns()`, `ValueBox` for `value_box()`, `Card` for `card()`.

```tsx
<PageSidebar title="Volcano plot" sidebarWidth={290} sidebar={<Sidebar />}>
  <LayoutColumns colWidths={[4, 4, 4]} fill={false}>
    <ValueBox title="Up" theme="warning">
      <TextOutput id="n_up" className="value-box-value" />
    </ValueBox>
    <ValueBox title="Down" theme="primary">
      <TextOutput id="n_down" className="value-box-value" />
    </ValueBox>
    <ValueBox title="Not significant" theme="secondary">
      <TextOutput id="n_ns" className="value-box-value" />
    </ValueBox>
  </LayoutColumns>
  <Card fullScreen>
    <CardHeader>Differential expression: synthetic dataset</CardHeader>
    <CardBody>
      <Module namespace="volcano">
        <PlotOutput id="plot" height="560px" click="click" />
      </Module>
    </CardBody>
  </Card>
</PageSidebar>
```

## Five hosted inputs

The sidebar holds two threshold sliders, a radio group, a checkbox and a
label count slider. The server renders each one with `host_input()`, so
they are Shiny's own widgets:

```{r}
bslibreact::host_input(
  output,
  "lfc",
  sliderInput("lfc", "|log2 fold change| threshold", min = 0, max = 5, value = 1, step = 0.1)
)
bslibreact::host_input(
  output,
  "pcol",
  radioButtons("pcol", "Significance metric", choices = c("Adjusted p" = "padj", "Raw p" = "pvalue"))
)
bslibreact::host_input(
  output,
  "dolabel",
  checkboxInput("dolabel", "Label top genes", value = TRUE)
)
```

The client mounts each one by its id plus `_ui`, with the component that
matches the widget:

```tsx
function Sidebar() {
  return (
    <>
      <SliderInput id="lfc_ui" />
      <SliderInput id="p_ui" />
      <RadioButtons id="pcol_ui" />
      <CheckboxInput id="dolabel_ui" />
      <SliderInput id="topn_ui" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Waiting for the inputs

A hosted input has no value until the client has mounted it, so the server
waits for each one with `req()`. An unchecked box is `FALSE`, which `req()`
would also stop on, so the checkbox is tested with `is.null()`:

```{r}
vol <- volcano_server(
  "volcano",
  de_results = reactive(de_results),
  lfc_threshold = reactive(req(input$lfc)),
  p_threshold = reactive(req(input$p)),
  p_col = reactive(req(input$pcol)),
  label_top_n = reactive({
    req(!is.null(input$dolabel), !is.null(input$topn))
    if (isTRUE(input$dolabel)) input$topn else 0L
  })
)
```

## A plot inside a Shiny module

The plot is rendered by a real module, `moduleServer("volcano", ...)`, so
its output id on the page is `volcano-plot`. On the client, `<Module
namespace="volcano">` adds the same prefix to every id inside it.
`<PlotOutput id="plot" click="click" />` therefore displays `volcano-plot`
and reports clicks as `volcano-click`, and the module reads them as
`input$click`.

## Value boxes that read text

The three counts are plain `renderText()` outputs:

```{r}
counts <- reactive(volcano_status_counts(vol$data()))
output$n_up <- renderText(as.character(counts()[["Up"]]))
output$n_down <- renderText(as.character(counts()[["Down"]]))
output$n_ns <- renderText(as.character(counts()[["NS"]]))
```

Each one shows through a `<TextOutput>` inside a `<ValueBox>`. The value box
itself is React markup and needs nothing from the server.

## Colours and fonts from `_brand.yml`

The folder has a `_brand.yml` file. `bs_theme(version = 5, brand = TRUE)`
reads it, and `page_deps(app_theme)` hands the page the themed CSS:

```{r}
app_theme <- bs_theme(version = 5, brand = TRUE)

ui <- page_react(
  title = "Volcano plot",
  theme = app_theme,
  bslibreact::page_deps(app_theme)
)
```

The value boxes in the screenshot take their orange, blue and grey from that
file, through the `warning`, `primary` and `secondary` themes. No colour is
set in the client.
